headline: CISA says max-severity GitLab RCE is exploited in the wild; Claude Code extension backdoored; Drupal Commerce flaw exploited

bullets.text: New: BleepingComputer reports CISA says the max-severity GitLab CE/EE flaw CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) is now exploited in the wild. It is in KEV with a 2026-11-01 due date; an attacker already tried it against Alpine Linux's instance.
The official Claude Code extension was trojanized with a persistent SSH backdoor, reported by The Hacker News (Cursor Marketplace listing) and Help Net Security.
Drupal warns a critical Commerce Core flaw is exploited in attacks; The Hacker News identifies it as authorization bypass CVE-2026-118539.

Cisco ASA/FTD VPN DoS zero-day CVE-2026-76418 is exploited and in KEV (due 2026-11-01). Separately, Cisco SD-WAN CVE-2026-20127 is exploited to deploy KeyDrift malware, tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network.

Binance links its $6.3 billion crypto theft to a compromised DevOps laptop; SecurityWeek reports hallmarks of North Korea's TraderTraitor. Polymarket confirms its attack hit a third-party provider after more than $2 million was drained from traders.
China-linked attackers used VMware ESX zero-day CVE-2026-41709 (KEV due 2026-11-11), and exploitation attempts against recently patched Oracle EBS flaw CVE-2026-101767 have begun.

actions: Patch self-managed GitLab CE/EE for CVE-2026-97229 today and review logs for exploitation; it is confirmed exploited in the wild.
If developers use the Claude Code extension in VS Code or Cursor, check versions against the vendor advisory and look for unexpected SSH keys or services.
If you run Drupal Commerce, apply the fix for CVE-2026-118539 now and review access logs for authorization bypass attempts.
Patch Cisco ASA/FTD for CVE-2026-76418 before 2026-11-01; patch Cisco SD-WAN for CVE-2026-20127 and hunt for KeyDrift malware.
Apply your distro's kernel fix for Linux CVE-2026-46300 before its 2026-10-31 KEV due date (tomorrow).
Patch VMware ESX for CVE-2026-41709 and confirm Oracle EBS CVE-2026-101767 is fixed.
